method: A hero is listed only when two independent tier lists both place it in their top group on the dates given: Game8 (updated 11 Nov 2026) and Pocket Gamer (updated 5 Nov 2026, version 10.11.0). No rating, score or rank is copied, and the order below is by release date, newest first, not by strength. The 'why' sentences are our own summaries of what each hero's skills do, checked against the hero's Game8 page (each updated 6 Nov 2026).
limits: Eight heroes passed the two-source test. Eight further heroes are in the top group of one list only and are left out. Neither source names a game mode for these heroes on the pages read, so `mode` is 'general' for all and `role` says what the hero does. The list covers heroes summoned at 5 stars only: no free or Heroic Grail hero passed the test.

shared_sources.title: Game8, Tier List (the hero is in its top group)
Pocket Gamer, Fire Emblem Heroes tier list (the hero is in its top tier)

picks.name: Hector: Of Strength
picks.role: Tank that takes hits for allies; engage partner
picks.why: Armored axe tank who takes hits for nearby allies and grants guaranteed follow-up attacks; his engage effect raises another hero's Special damage.

picks.name: Gullveig: Seer Reborn
picks.why: Cavalry mage who weakens nearby foes at the start of the turn and can act again up to twice in one turn.

picks.name: Edelgard: Beyond Bounds
picks.why: Armored axe hero who counterattacks at any range, cuts incoming damage and grants status effects to herself and nearby allies at the start of every phase.

picks.name: Sigurd: Legacy of Justice
picks.role: Melee attacker who moves again after combat
picks.why: Cavalry sword hero who damages nearby foes before combat, reduces what he takes and moves again afterwards.

picks.name: Tsubasa: Summoned Girl
picks.why: Flying mage who gives nearby allies warp movement and the Cadenza effect, and boosts her own stats in combat.

picks.name: Baldr: Eternal Shimmer
picks.why: Flying mage who can attack twice, moves again after combat, boosts nearby allies and survives one lethal hit.

picks.name: Roy: Of Binding
picks.why: Infantry sword hero who counterattacks at any range and fights well on both turns, and whose Emblem effect adds a once-per-turn survival effect.

picks.name: Lucina: Of Awakening
picks.role: Ranged attacker and team support; engage partner
picks.why: Infantry archer whose Special reduces damage to nearby allies and who can act again after using an Assist.
